title.original: OSWorld-MCP: Benchmarking MCP Tool Invocation In Computer-Use Agents
title.zh: OSWorld-MCP：计算机使用代理中的基准MCP工具调用
title.en: OSWorld-MCP: Benchmarking MCP Tool Invocation In Computer-Use Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: OSWorld-MCP 交付了可复现的桌面、MCP 工具与终态核验 Harness，使 GUI 与工具调用能力能够统一测量。
inclusion_reason.en: OSWorld-MCP delivers a reproducible desktop, MCP tool suite, and outcome harness that jointly measures GUI and tool-invocation capability.

abstract.zh: OSWorld-MCP 在真实桌面环境中同时测量 MCP 工具调用、GUI 操作与决策，让具备工具的计算机 Agent 和纯 GUI Agent 获得可比评测。
abstract.en: OSWorld-MCP jointly measures MCP tool invocation, GUI operation, and decision making in a real desktop environment, enabling fair comparison of tool-enabled and GUI-only computer agents.

problem.zh: 既有桌面基准几乎只考察 GUI，直接比较接入 MCP 工具的 Agent 会混淆工具能力、界面操作能力与决策质量。
problem.en: Existing desktop benchmarks largely test GUI interaction, so comparing MCP-enabled agents with GUI-only agents confounds tool competence, interface control, and decision quality.

approach.zh: 作者用自动代码生成和人工筛选构建跨常用应用的工具集合，并把工具与 OSWorld 任务结合，对调用、操作和最终完成分别观测。
approach.en: Automated code generation plus manual validation produces tools across common applications, which are paired with OSWorld tasks to observe invocation, GUI behavior, and completion separately.

system_design.zh: 基准由可复现实机环境、MCP 工具服务器、GUI 动作通道、任务编排器和按终态核验的评测器组成。
system_design.en: The benchmark integrates a reproducible desktop environment, MCP tool servers, a GUI action channel, task orchestration, and end-state evaluators.

key_results.zh: 接入 MCP 通常提高任务成功率，但最强模型也很少主动调用工具，表明工具发现与选择而非工具可用性仍是主要瓶颈。
key_results.en: MCP access generally improves task success, yet even strong models invoke tools infrequently, indicating that discovery and selection—not mere availability—remain major bottlenecks.

limitations.zh: 工具集合只覆盖少量桌面应用，且人工验证后的工具质量高于开放生态；结果未必代表噪声更大、权限更复杂的真实 MCP 市场。
limitations.en: The tool suite covers a limited set of desktop applications and is cleaner than the open ecosystem, so results may not transfer to noisier marketplaces with more complex permissions.

workloads: Computer-use tasks with MCP and GUI actions

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
